parole.testo: From the Italian bergamasco (“from Bergamo”), itself from German Bergheim (“mountain home”).

parole.significato: Ruler or monarch of a grand duchy.
parole.testo: From grand + duke, after Middle French and French grand duc /grand-duc, itself after titles in other languages, especially Italian granduca, German Großherzog, and Russian вели́кий князь (velíkij knjazʹ). Doublet of grand-duc.
